episodes.title: Las dos venganzas
episodes.summary: When madam Serafina's affair with baker Simon turns sour, her burning need for revenge threatens to destroy both of their lives.

episodes.title: Historia de las casas
episodes.summary: Arcángela seeks Captain Bedoya's help for Serafina's revenge. The Baladro's brothel empire is threatened by a morality law and a cunning secretary.

episodes.title: La mala noche
episodes.summary: An incident with Beto leads police to close "México Lindo." The sisters seek refuge at the "Casino del Danzón" and invest in a ranch to save themselves.

episodes.title: Los dientes de Blanca
episodes.summary: The fate of Blanca, one of the women at the brothel, sets off a series of sinister incidents that end right in the Baladros' backyard.

episodes.title: La ley marcial
episodes.summary: Bedoya rules the brothel with an iron fist as the women rebel. Meanwhile, Teófilo struggles to make ends meet at the ranch — then tragedy strikes.

episodes.title: Llega la policía
episodes.summary: When Serafina is targeted by a detective, everyone retreats to the ranch. As police dig deeper, the skeletons in the Baladro family's closet emerge.
